description: Defines modulation schemes and related functions for a radio communication system, including enum class for modulation types, conversion functions, and constants.

classes.name: modulation_scheme
classes.description: Enumeration of modulation schemes as per TS38.211, including PI_2_BPSK, BPSK, QPSK, QAM16, QAM64, QAM256.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts a modulation_scheme enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: modulation_scheme_from_string
methods.description: Parses a string to return the corresponding modulation_scheme enum value.

methods.name: get_bits_per_symbol
methods.description: Returns the number of bits per symbol for a given modulation scheme.
